per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.5% — per FCA Open Banking API uptime obligation

security.access_control: TPP must present valid OAuth access token with vrp:consent scope. Token validated by SVC-100.
security.audit: Consent request logged with TPP client_id, parameters, and timestamp

security.data_classification: PII + Financial — customer identity, account details, consent parameters
security.access_control: SCA required for consent grant. SCA assertion reference stored as proof of authorisation.
security.audit: Consent grant with SCA assertion_ref logged immutably — regulatory evidence

latency.payment_execution_p95: < 2,000ms end-to-end (consent check + fraud score + FPS initiation)

security.data_classification: Financial — payment amount, account numbers, FPS reference
security.access_control: PISP access token with vrp:payment scope. Consent parameter enforcement is the primary access control.
security.audit: Payment execution logged with consent_id, amount, fps_end_to_end_id

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.9% — revocation must be real-time; cannot defer revocation

security.access_control: Customer-initiated revocation requires SCA. PISP-initiated deletion requires valid PISP access token.
security.audit: Revocation logged immutably with reason and initiating party

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: VRP Consent Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: VRP consent records (including revoked and expired consents) retained for minimum 5 years. VRP payment records retained for minimum 5 years. Required for PSR/FCA audit and customer right to evidence.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: PSR 2017 and FCA cVRP framework require PISP accountability trail; customer may dispute transactions.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Consent Parameter Enforcement — Idempotent
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Monthly aggregate enforcement must be idempotent. If concurrent VRP payments are submitted simultaneously, the bank must ensure the monthly aggregate is not breached via optimistic locking on the VrpConsent record.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Race conditions on the monthly aggregate counter could allow payments exceeding the consented limit, creating customer harm and regulatory liability.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Consent Dashboard — Real-Time Visibility
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Customer-facing consent dashboard must reflect consent status changes within 5 seconds (SLA). Revoked consents must appear as revoked immediately.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: FCA Consumer Duty principle — customers must be able to exercise control over their payment mandates without friction.

regulatory_slas.name: FCA cVRP — Consent Parameter Transparency
regulatory_slas.requirement: All VRP consent parameters (max amount, frequency, category, expiry) must be presented in plain language to the customer before consent grant
regulatory_slas.source: FCA cVRP Framework, Consumer Duty (FCA PRIN 12)
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Uninformed consent; potential mis-selling finding; FCA enforcement

regulatory_slas.name: PSD2 / PSR 2017 — SCA for Consent
regulatory_slas.requirement: SCA is required at the point of VRP consent authorisation. Subsequent VRP payments within consent parameters do not require per-payment SCA.
regulatory_slas.source: PSR 2017 Regulation 100, EBA RTS on SCA
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Unauthorised payment liability on the bank; FCA enforcement

regulatory_slas.name: FCA Open Banking — API Uptime
regulatory_slas.requirement: Open Banking APIs (consent endpoint, payment endpoint) must meet 99.5% monthly uptime
regulatory_slas.source: FCA Open Banking API Performance Standard (CMA Order)
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: CMA Order breach; FCA reporting obligation; potential fine
